title: Web search optimization
description: Technical and content checks for pages intended to appear in organic search.

sources.title: Google Search Central, SEO Starter Guide
Google Search Central, How to use Search Console

rules.instruction: Give each public page a clear search intent, a descriptive title and a visible heading. Link to it from a relevant page with text that describes the destination.
rules.verification: Inspect the rendered page and internal link. Confirm that the content answers the intended query and the title distinguishes it from nearby pages.

rules.instruction: For pages meant to appear in search, review status codes, indexability and canonical targets before publishing. Plan redirects when replacing public URLs.
rules.verification: Inspect representative URLs and redirect targets. After release, use Search Console or the team's approved indexing report to investigate unexpected exclusions.
